lines.text: He's the OG member of our club.

data.define: Someone or something that was first and respected.

example.text: He's the OG member of our club.

misuse.text: Don't call your new friend 'OG' on day one.

publish.title: What does "OG" mean?
publish.value: OG = The original or classic one. Example: "He's the OG member of our club." (very casual English, US).
